title: High Blood Pressure
ayurvedicView: High blood pressure involves Pitta and Vata. Stress reduction and dietary changes support cardiovascular health.
remedies: Slow deep breathing exercises (4-6 breaths/min) for 10 min daily
Keep tea and coffee to a cup or two a day
seeDoctor: A reading of 180/120 or higher, especially with chest pain, breathlessness or a severe headache: call 112
Dizziness or fainting after starting or changing a medicine
Never stop blood pressure medicines without your doctor
